title: No Arc Furance Sounds (Immersive Engineering)
description: Disables the Arc Furnace Sounds when crafting from Immersive Engineering
body:
# __**No Arc Furnace**__

## **__Overview__**

Simply removes both the lightning sound as well as the Arc Furnace sound from playing when the Arc Furnace is crafting items

## __**Support**__

Join the BBL [Discord](https://discord.gg/benbenlaw) for support, report bugs and suggest features or additions. You can also support me on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/benbenlaw) to gain Alpha access to Modpacks and Mods in dev
